instruction.text: What kind of problems did Jake and Norbert have in the story? Drag the problems to their character.

atoms.sound: doesn’t like sitting next to his classmate

atoms.a: Do you think Jake could have been nicer to Norbert?

end.text: Jake didn’t understand what Norbert was dealing with. If Jake had tried to be nice to Norbert and talk to him more, maybe the fight could have been avoided.

atoms.a: Do you think Norbert should have tackled Jake?

end.text: Fighting is never OK. When you’re feeling bad, it’s important to talk to people and share how you feel. Talking can help solve conflict.

atoms.a: Were both the boys responsible for the fight?

end.text: Both the boys played roles in the events leading to the fight. They could have made other decisions that would have led to a better resolution.

instruction.text: Now let’s think about cause and effect. Imagine that a year has passed since the end of the story and both Jake and Norbert are in year six together. Match the effects to their causes.

atoms.a: Norbert has joined the school football team. He practices every week and has games on Saturdays.
atoms.b: Norbert has found more friends and knows more kids in his classes.

atoms.a: Jake and Norbert have band lessons together. They both play the drums.
atoms.b: Jake and Norbert talk with each other during class and are much friendlier.

atoms.a: Jake learnt more about Norbert’s life.
atoms.b: He felt bad about being mean to Norbert. He realised he had judged Norbert without knowing him.

instruction.text: Now let’s think about cause and effect. Imagine that a year has passed since the end of the story and both Jake and Norbert are in year six together. Match the effects to their causes.

atoms.a: Another boy in Jake’s class doesn’t seem to have any friends.
atoms.b: Jake sits next to him, and they work on homework together.
When he feels angry, he spends a lot of time with Rufus or talks to his new friends.

atoms.a: Sometimes, Jake still feels like he is unlucky.
atoms.b: Jake tries to think about all the things he has to be grateful for.
